rust_summary: looking up translated registry names and content namespace owners (`native_display_name`, `native_owner_mod`).
doc_summary: `display_name(registry, id)` accepts every registry, including server-synchronized registries: current-language then pinned English translation keys, with entity/effect/biome/stat/attribute aliases, item/block fallback, enchantment descriptions and jukebox-song text components. Registries without translated labels (for example sounds or loot tables) return the original ID, never an invented name. `owner_mod(namespace)` returns the active content owner's `(id, manifest name)`, Minecraft for `minecraft`, or `None` when unknown. Bundles need fragment @API:registry_names@.
